goal: A fish, one object, large in the middle of the picture on a plain light background, for a word check row.
colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element picture. Picture 1 is a 3D render of a round blue fish with a yellow belly, yellow fins and a yellow tail fin, and one big round eye with a white highlight, on a gray background with a gray ground shadow. Ignore the gray background and the shadow: do not copy them. Draw the same fish with the same shape, the same colors, and the same proportions as in picture 1, as a smooth, clean, bright, soft, round 3D render with a plain white background. The picture to make: a square picture of exactly ONE fish, large in the middle, filling most of the square, seen exactly from the side (a side view), the fish faces the left edge of the picture, the whole fish from the nose to the tail fin. Exactly one fish: no second one, no copies, and nothing else in the picture. The background is plain white and empty, with at most a very soft shadow under the object. The eyes are big, round, and clean, each with a big dark pupil and white highlights, with no pale flaps or marks around them. The page text is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture of one object. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No fine detail, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. The object outline is one closed shape. No fur strands, scales, grain, or texture lines. The fish body is one closed outline. The fins and the tail are closed shapes with a few thick fin lines. No scale marks. Each eye of the animal is one closed outline with one big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it, with no extra thin rings. Draw the fin rays as a few thick lines only. Every line inside the object ends on another line, with no loose ends. Draw only the object: no ground line, no shadow, no background shapes. Do not draw any text, letters, or numbers.
